stages.text: Finish all five chapters. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter - there is no mission replay. In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth, before the chapter ends.
stages.title: Play the story, save the meditation

stages.text: Finish the character questlines as they open: Andy (Lucia only), Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone (Jason only) and Bret (Jason only). They all stay open after the story.
stages.title: Side questlines

stages.text: Yasmani's jobs unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies; That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4 unlocks bank vaults. Partner robberies, Combat Focus and the VCIA jet all live here.
stages.title: Robberies open up

stages.text: Stunts, races, shooting ranges, drone races, fishing, arcade games, card sets, WAiNK scans, challenges, vehicles and the full map. Scan vehicles and study animals from the start.
stages.title: Activities and collectibles

stages.text: Launder $250,000 in marked bills, spend $100,000 in shops, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles. Robberies fund it all.
stages.title: Money and garages

stages.text: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks strands - race Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 - then the misc trophies: the Ocean Beach cocktail, the showroom Banshee, max Strength for both leads, 500 profile actions and the UFO.
stages.title: Strangers and misc cleanup

stages.text: After the credits, work the checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is lenient - closer to 60% true completion - but some lines need everything. A Long Road pops, then the platinum.
stages.title: 100% checklist and platinum

title: Roadmap to the platinum - Vice Got a Price!
